note: Three l's. A slip of the keyboard in the export; the town is Scilla, Reggio Calabria. Left alone it made a second, empty Scilla that the atlas could not place.
Two n's. The comune is Soriano Calabro, Vibo Valentia — the Briatico end of the family.
A third spelling of the same town, with the province left off. Merged so that one place is one place.

The province added so the gazetteer can find it. There is a Soriano nel Cimino in Lazio and a Soriano in Colombia; without the province and region the map has to guess — and every other Vibo Valentia place in this archive is written «Town, Vibo Valentia, Calabria».
